note: SCORER_VERSION -> sha256 of the scoring code (verify.scorer_sha256: benchkit.py and the organizer Lean tool sources); one row per released scorer, never edited.

1.0.0-rc.10.2: Removes a recorded-only diagnostic field and the compiled-file copies from bundles: a bundle holds the editable sources and the kernel export at its top level; scoring unchanged (the node count, dag_nodes_v1 and every verdict are the same). Package and task hashes change because the scoring code ships in every package.
1.0.0-rc.10.3: What a participant reads names the project's command and repositories: ./submit points to the submissions repository MathCompressionBench/mcb-submissions and to `mcb intake add` and `mcb verify`, TASK.json's commands say `mcb`, ./check prints `scorer mcb <version>`, and the usage lines say mcb.
Every package carries LICENSE-Apache-2.0 and NOTICE.

Scoring unchanged (the node count, dag_nodes_v1 and every verdict are the same). Package and task hashes change because the scoring code and TASK.json ship in every package. Bundles made from the packages of 1.0.0-rc.10.2 are still accepted and are verified with the tools of that release.
1.0.0-rc.11: Adds the task set oai-v1: 175 tasks made from the published math challenges of github.com/openai/math, on Lean v4.34.1 (the lcbench-v1 tasks stay on Lean v4.32.0; each package names its toolchain).

The kernel replay of a task whose declarations live in many modules checks several modules at once (one process per module, as many as the CPUs available, at most 16); the report is the same as when they are checked one at a time. make-task replays its build once.
The import rule reads the import forms of Lean's module system (`public import`, `meta import`, `import all M`), which the oai-v1 sources use.

Scoring unchanged (the node count, dag_nodes_v1 and every verdict are the same). Package and task hashes change because the scoring code ships in every package. Bundles made from the packages of 1.0.0-rc.10.3 and 1.0.0-rc.10.2 are still accepted and are verified with the tools of those releases.
